description: Liste des communes volontaires pour s'adapter au recul du trait de côte is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de la Transition écologique. This dataset brings together municipalities whose urban planning action and planning policy must be adapted to hydrosedimentary phenomena leading to coastal erosion. This list was taken by decree pursuant to Article L321-15 of the Environmental Code, introduced by Article 239 of Law No 2021-1104 of 22 August 2021, known as the Climate and Resilience Law. Coverage: Ministère de la Transition écologique. The portal shows the English title as "List of voluntary municipalities to adapt to the setback of the coastline" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministère de la Transition écologique. Its keywords include erosion-cotiere, mer-et-littoral, adaptation, trait-de-cote, decret, loi-climat-et-resilience. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2026-02-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
